caption:
Four astronauts floated through the ISS hatch today, 400 km above Earth, after an 8-hour trip from the launchpad.

Crew-13 will spend the next several months living on the station, running experiments in zero gravity. Things like how cells grow, how the human body handles long-term spaceflight, and how materials behave without gravity. Results that no lab on the ground can replicate.

The ISS has had people living aboard it without a single break since November 2000. Every crew exchange keeps that streak alive and moves one step closer to permanent human presence beyond Earth.
